description: This file defines the AlertsController class for managing alert notifications within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes actions for retrieving alerts, adding new alerts, marking alerts as read, and redirecting based on alert data.

classes.name: AlertsController
classes.description: Controller class for handling alert-related actions such as fetching, adding, marking as read, and redirecting for alerts.

methods.name: action_get
methods.description: Retrieves unread alerts for the current user and sets view variables for rendering.

methods.name: action_add
methods.description: Creates a new alert or retrieves existing one based on the reminder_id, then returns a JSON response indicating whether to show a reminder popup.

methods.name: action_markAsRead
methods.description: Marks a specific alert as read based on the record ID provided.

methods.name: action_redirect
methods.description: Redirects the user to the alert's URL and marks the alert as read.
